crossRefs.note: You who fear Yahweh, trust in Yahweh! He is their help and their shield.
He will bless those who fear Yahweh, both small and great.
House of Israel, praise Yahweh! House of Aaron, praise Yahweh!
House of Levi, praise Yahweh! You who fear Yahweh, praise Yahweh!
He will fulfill the desire of those who fear him. He also will hear their cry, and will save them.
Oh give thanks to Yahweh. Call on his name. Make what he has done known among the peoples.
His mercy is for generations of generations on those who fear him.
Glory in his holy name. Let the heart of those who seek Yahweh rejoice.
that I may see the prosperity of your chosen, that I may rejoice in the gladness of your nation, that I may glory with…
Give thanks to Yahweh, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.
Let the redeemed by Yahweh say so, whom he has redeemed from the hand of the adversary,
House of Israel, praise Yahweh! House of Aaron, praise Yahweh!
House of Levi, praise Yahweh! You who fear Yahweh, praise Yahweh!
Whoever offers the sacrifice of thanksgiving glorifies me, and prepares his way so that I will show God’s salvation to…
Therefore a strong people will glorify you. A city of awesome nations will fear you.
The shepherds returned, glorifying and praising God for all the things that they had heard and seen, just as it was…
Or don’t you know that your body is a temple of the Holy Spirit who is in you, whom you have from God? You are not your…
for you were bought with a price. Therefore glorify God in your body and in your spirit, which are God’s.
Whether therefore you eat, or drink, or whatever you do, do all to the glory of God.
Who wouldn’t fear you, Lord, and glorify your name? For you only are holy. For all the nations will come and worship…
Posterity shall serve him. Future generations shall be told about the Lord.
you offspring of Israel his servant, you children of Jacob, his chosen ones.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: You who fear Yahweh, praise him! All you descendants of Jacob, glorify him! Stand in awe of him, all you descendants of Israel!
translations.bsb: You who fear the LORD, praise Him! All descendants of Jacob, honor Him! All offspring of Israel, revere Him!
translations.kjv: Ye that fear the LORD, praise him; all ye the seed of Jacob, glorify him; and fear him, all ye the seed of Israel.
translations.asv: Ye that fear Jehovah, praise him; All ye the seed of Jacob, glorify him; And stand in awe of him, all ye the seed of Israel.
